rv.q: Ballet Shoes is a perfect Christmas show, and if it didn’t warm the heart of even the biggest Grinch I would be thoroughly surprised.
This is a splendid piece of inventive theatre that's also great family entertainment.
It is a triumph for The National Theatre and an unmissable highlight of the season.
With limitless charm, wry humour and a sincere heart, this revival of Ballet Shoes is a must-see for all the family.
The end result is a thoroughly engaging and delightful tale of three sisters learning to rise above their own limitations and battle those restrictions imposed on them by society.
A full five star brava for this inspiring show!

cn.t: Critics praise this enchanting revival of Noel Streatfeild's beloved tale as a delightful festive treat. Katy Rudd's confident direction and Kendall Feaver's intelligent adaptation capture both timeless charm and refreshing vitality.
